receipt.completion_event_id: UUID of the exact complete-one-action event

request.idempotency_key: New UUID per intended Undo; retain on lost response

receipt.completion_event_id: UUID of the reversed completion event

authority: Both operations require verified partner authority. Another verified partner may undo the completion; event identity selects the change, not its author.
guards: Exactly one tenant-scoped next_action or capture_post_call_action must match action_id.
The current numeric version must equal both base_version and the selected completion event version.
The selected event must be a tenant-scoped complete-one-action status change from open to done for the same action table, subject and owner.
The current action must still be done. Later edits, moves, owner changes, dropping, reopening and recompletion cannot be overwritten.
effects: Only the selected task status changes from done to open.
A call task completed_at becomes null. A next_action records updated_by.
The normal row trigger increments version. One reopen-one-action event records completion_event_id.
Sibling tasks, deal plan and Inbox dispositions are unchanged. No migration is required.

retry.same_key: Same canonical request and authenticated principal replay the original receipt with replayed=true within the shared envelope replay window. Concurrent identical retries serialize before receipt lookup.
retry.key_reuse: Changed arguments, verb or principal refuse key_reuse.
retry.expired_receipt: After the shared replay window, current-version protection still prevents repeating the mutation; callers must re-read rather than infer success.
retry.uncertainty: Retain the exact request after transport failure. Do not assume either success or refusal without a receipt.
retry.window: 30 days, defined by replay-receipt.ts and enforced by the tool_call ledger

legacy_completion_receipts: Receipts created before this contract may lack completion_event_id. They do not authorize guessed event lookup or Undo.
invalid_completion: The completion event ID is invalid, does not match the exact unchanged task, or the task is not currently completed.
